## Outcome
Done. The `continue` in the `checkout()` loop is now a throw, so checkout raises `out of stock <sku>` when a reservation fails, matching its doc comment.

## Changes
- `/tmp/vcmp/w/t2/src/checkout.ts`, line 6: `if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { continue; }` → `if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { throw new Error('out of stock ' + sku); }`. Nothing else in the file changed.

## Verification
- Throw on reserve failure: met by reading the edited line. I did not run `npm test`, per the brief; the lead will run it.

## Open issues
None. Note that `checkout.test.ts` expects `/out of stock B2/` for a B2 reservation of 1 (B2 has 0 stock), so this change should satisfy it. Reserving only throws after earlier skus in the list have already been reserved, so a partial reservation can remain on failure. The doc comment doesn't say otherwise, so I left it alone.
